title: Removals of CIA Building Passes
title_ja: CIAビル入館許可証の取り消し
summary: Memorandum requesting the removal of CIA building passes for members of the Inter-agency Defector Committee, including Army and Air Force personnel. Notes addition of specific buildings to certain passes.
summary_ja: 陸軍および空軍の職員を含む、省庁間亡命者委員会のメンバーの CIA ビル入館許可証の取り消しを求める覚書。特定のパスに特定の建物を追加した旨のメモ。
